entities.summary: Jarbas Gonçalves Passarinho was a Brazilian military officer and politician. Passarinho began his political career when he was appointed Governor of Pará. He served as head of several government ministries during both the Brazilian military government (1964–1985) and the transition to democracy. His government portfolio's included Minister of Labor (1967–1969), Minister of Education (1969–1974), Minister of Social Security (1983–1985), and Minister of Justice (1990–1992). Passarinho was also a member of the Federal Senate, representing Pará for two tenures during military rule and the return to democracy, including a period as President of the Federal Senate from 1981 to 1983.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As Governor of Pará and head of several government ministries during Brazil's military rule, Passarinho played a significant role in shaping the country's social security system. His tenure as Minister of Social Security from 1983 to 1985 had lasting impacts on Brazil's pension system.
